records.issue_text: Fallback find by externalCalendarId only runs when externalCalendarId is falsy, so the find predicate compares against undefined and never matches, breaking the calendar id fallback (CalendarService.ts:253-256, 312-315)
records.rationale: In the Google CalendarService, the fallback `event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId` is only evaluated in the ternary's else branch, i.e., when `externalCalendarId` is falsy. The predicate then compares `cal.externalId === externalCalendarId` where externalCalendarId is null/undefined/empty, so the find never matches and the fallback always yields undefined (falling through to undefined/primary). Same dead logic appears in updateEvent and deleteEvent. This is a real defect introduced by the diff.

records.issue_text: Iterating multiple destination calendars with the same integration type but no credentialId can create duplicate calendar events per credential (EventManager.ts:337-338)
records.rationale: In EventManager.ts createAllCalendarEvents, the diff loops over event.destinationCalendar; for each destination without credentialId it runs `this.calendarCredentials.filter((c) => c.type === destination.integration)` and creates an event for every matching credential. If two destination calendars share the same integration type and lack credentialId, the same credentials are iterated twice, creating duplicate events on the same calendar — a plausible defect visible directly in the diff's new loop logic.
